component: NNTP request reset and response dispatch

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The assigned patch adds this._nextAction = null to NntpClient._reset. Fixed response dispatch calls this._nextAction?.(res), while _actionDone completes callbacks, resets the request state, then calls onIdle. Clearing the saved response action therefore belongs to the reusable-client reset boundary. Later reset fields are comparison only. Available Bug reports distinguish FIN during a pending response from idle close and RST cleanup; they do not prove every reconnect path. Bug comment27 is unavailable and review is deferred. No new socket or automated test ran.
title: Clear the NNTP response action when resetting a reusable client
